# Real-corpus fixture attribution

The directories below are snapshots of publicly available open-source
project documentation, used as retrieval test corpora. The documentation
belongs to the respective projects and is redistributed here unmodified
(apart from file selection and, where noted in the seed yaml, `.mdx → .md`
renaming) under each project's own license. They are test fixtures only —
none of this content ships in the published npm package.

| Corpus | Upstream project | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `biome/` | Biome | <https://github.com/biomejs/website> (`src/content/docs`) |
| `bun/` | Bun | <https://github.com/oven-sh/bun> (`docs/`) |
| `drizzle/` | Drizzle ORM | <https://github.com/drizzle-team/drizzle-orm-docs> |
| `effect/` | Effect | <https://github.com/Effect-TS/website> |
| `hono/` | Hono | <https://github.com/honojs/website> |
| `prisma/` | Prisma | <https://github.com/prisma/docs> |
| `tanstack/` | TanStack Query | <https://github.com/TanStack/query> (`docs/`) |
| `trpc/` | tRPC | <https://github.com/trpc/trpc> (`www/docs`) |
| `turborepo/` | Turborepo | <https://github.com/vercel/turborepo> (`docs/`) |
| `valibot/` | Valibot | <https://github.com/fabian-hiller/valibot> (`website/`) |
| `vitest/` | Vitest | <https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest> (`docs/`) |
| `zod/` | Zod | <https://github.com/colinhacks/zod> |

If you are a maintainer of one of these projects and would like your
documentation removed or attributed differently, please open an issue.
